envelope.description: One file-selection predicate shared by the full index and the cross-file pass

body.title: One file-selection predicate shared by the full index and the cross-file pass
body.summary: Extract the full index's per-file rule (src/indexer/index.ts:630-640: the repository's ignore list, a parser for the extension or basename, not generated or minified) plus the artifact parser's skip rules (SKIP_BASENAMES and MAX_SIZE, artifact.ts:89, :117-118, exported for it) into one predicate returning 'selected' | 'not-code' | 'excluded-by-ignore'; fullIndex's selection loop calls it. Story s6 later replaces its ignore part. Anchors: src/indexer/index.ts:630 lists files with listRepoFiles(repoPath, resolveRepoIgnore(repoPath)); :634-635 keep a file only when a parser handles its extension or basename; :636-639 skip isGeneratedOrMinified (GENERATED_FILE_PATTERN at :90); the artifact parser returns no entities for SKIP_BASENAMES or source over MAX_SIZE = 256 KB (src/indexer/parser/artifact.ts:89, :117-118).
acceptanceChecks: fullIndex selects exactly the same files as before on the existing indexer fixtures
The predicate classes a .png, a .min.js, a lock file and a JSON over 256 KB as 'not-code', a .ts under an ignored directory as 'excluded-by-ignore', and a .css/.json under the limit as 'selected'

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/file-selection.test.ts: predicate classes .png, .min.js, lock file, >256 KB JSON as not-code, ignored .ts as excluded-by-ignore, .css/.json as selected
existing indexer full-index fixtures select the same files
